ideas.title: The $9 Billion Somali Fraud Scheme: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the details of the $9 billion Somali fraud scheme and the hearing with Minnesota Gov. Walz and AG Ellison.
ideas.angle: The political and financial implications of the scheme.
questions: What were the findings of the hearing?
How will the scheme be investigated and prosecuted?
ideas.insight: This story requires a deep dive into the financial and political aspects of the scheme, and the implications for Minnesota and Somalia.

ideas.title: The Rise of Fraud in Minnesota: A Pattern of Corruption?
ideas.description: Investigate the multiple fraud schemes in Minnesota, including the $21 million Medicaid fraud scheme and the $90 million fraud scheme.
ideas.angle: The pattern of corruption in Minnesota and the need for accountability.
questions: What are the common factors among the fraud schemes?
How can the state prevent similar schemes in the future?
ideas.insight: This story requires an analysis of the data and patterns among the fraud schemes, and the need for accountability and prevention.
